description: Configure ambient memory injection. When enabled, ZeroDB automatically retrieves relevant memories before each tool call and prepends them as context — agents get memory without calling recall() explicitly.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier to configure (scopes config to this agent)

auto_trace.description: Automatically store tool responses as memories for future recall (default: false)

enabled.description: Enable or disable auto-context injection (default: false)

max_results.description: Number of memories to inject per tool call (1-20, default: 10)

synthesis_style.description: Format of injected context: narrative prose, bullet points, or structured summary

name: zerodb_configure_auto_context
